items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Tommy Flanagan knows a lot, Hank Jones.

ctx.x: Nope. Jimmy Rowles is gone now, he knew an awful lot of tunes. Tommy Flanagan knows a lot, Hank Jones. Those guys know — and I think Tommy, he knows more of the bebop tunes. I sort of only knew the real early bebop tunes, and I don’t know the charts later on. Tommy knows them and he probably knows most of the tunes I know, and a few that I don’t. Hank Jones would have to be — Ellis Larkin, a very elegant piano player, I love his playing and he knows it. But I don’t know.
I know. It’d be hard to actually count them, but when you get on these gigs, at these jazz parties, how do you come to a consensus about what’s going to be played?
